fields.label: Buyer assignment decides what Sales Managers and Sales Admins see
fields.description: On: a Sales Manager sees the buyers they are assigned to (Sales Officer, Primary POC or Secondary POC), and a Sales Admin's lists open on the buyers they are Secondary POC of, with Show All for the rest. Off: both see every buyer, as before. Sales Officers always see only their assigned buyers. Check the coverage report before switching it on.

fields.label: Default Primary POC(s)
fields.description: Added to every new buyer. A Sales Officer may add more Primary POCs but cannot remove these.

fields.label: Escalate Pending Approval After (hours)
fields.description: A buyer still Pending Approval this many hours after it was created is escalated once to its Primary POC(s) and Secondary POC.
